name: Melchizedek
role: King of Salem and priest of God Most High
summary: He appears once in Genesis: after Abram's rescue of Lot, Melchizedek king of Salem, priest of God Most High, brings out bread and wine and blesses Abram, and Abram gives him a tenth of everything. Psalm 110 speaks of a king who is a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek, and Hebrews reads him as a figure of Christ.
body: His name means king of righteousness, and Salem peace, as Hebrews points out. Genesis gives him no parents and no story beyond three verses, and he blesses Abram in the name of God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.

Psalm 110 has the LORD swear to the king at his right hand, “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.” Hebrews builds on both passages: without recorded father, mother or genealogy, he is like the Son of God, a priest greater than Levi, since Levi, in Abraham, paid him the tenth.

moments.text: Levi paid the tenth in Abraham

later.text: Josephus identifies Salem with Jerusalem, and Psalm 76:2 sets Salem beside Zion.
Among the Dead Sea Scrolls, 11QMelchizedek (11Q13) presents Melchizedek as a heavenly figure who brings release and judgment at the end of days.
